# appgatesdp_discovered_apps_configuration (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_app_types` (Attributes List) List of custom types to group apps according to their ports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_app_types))
- `groups_claim` (String) The claim used to extract group information from the token.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
